link_math.status: hypothetical bounded scenarios, not measured cable behavior
link_math.return_model_note: Five equal returns and one equal feed imply Rreturn=Rloop/6; real grounds/shields have unknown impedance. Shell omitted in equal-conductor model.
link_math.JTAG_note: Uses drive/load table voltage bounds, not fixed output voltage drops. XEM 1.71–1.89 V is an I/O-standard envelope, not verified regulator tolerance.

power_contract_math.status: proposed engineering constraints, not selected cable or installed source circuit
power_contract_math.efuse_accuracy_note: Conditional extrapolation of headline ±7.5%; table does not give a separate guaranteed 3160-ohm row. Vendor clarification/acceptance required.
power_contract_math.damping_model_limit: Lumped passive step model only; not hot-plug or constant-power converter stability proof.

throughput_math.status: arithmetic only, no firmware or timing proof
assumptions: ADC protocol must yield the claimed valid 12-bit samples
20-byte metadata/CRC budget and one alignment byte are proposals
all three serial lanes must individually preserve valid 8b/10b coding and running disparity
receiver buffering and PC-to-disk throughput are separate requirements
